records.subject: Ag1+/Sb3+ cationic radii mismatch (115/76 p.m.)
records.conditions: AgSbTe2 likely possesses disorder; source radii unit retained
records.quote: AgSbTe2 likely possesses a cationic disorder due to its significant cationic radii mismatch and cationic charge imbalance between Ag1+ (115 p.m.) and Sb3+ (76 p.m.), leading to poor electronic transport properties.

records.subject: Decreased cationic charge imbalance using Mg2+, Zn2+ or Ca2+
records.quote: We demonstrate that decreasing the cationic charge imbalance (Mg2+ (72 p.m.), Zn2+ (74 p.m.) and Ca2+ (100 p.m.)) or ionic radii (Y3+ (96 p.m.)) can substantially decrease the cationic disorder in AgSbTe2.
